Requirements: To be eligible for admission to the Master of Advanced Architectural Design (MAAD) program, applicants must hold a professional degree in architecture (Bachelor of Architecture or Master of Architecture) from an accredited program in the U.S. or an international equivalent. Required application materials include a digital portfolio of design work, a Statement of Purpose, a Personal History Statement, three letters of recommendation, transcripts, and a curriculum vitae (CV) or resume. A minimum grade point average (GPA) of 3.0 is required.
Program name: Master of Advanced Architectural Design

Requirements: Minimum requirements for admission to graduate study at UC Berkeley: A bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution; A satisfactory scholastic average, usually a minimum grade-point average (GPA) of 3.0 (B) on a 4.0 scale; and Enough undergraduate training to do graduate work in your chosen field. In addition to the University’s requirements, applicants must provide: 3 letters of recommendation, Statement of Purpose, Personal History Statement, Resume, Official Transcripts, and Evidence of English language proficiency.
Program name: Master of Advanced Study in Engineering

Requirements: To apply for the Ph.D. program in African American Studies, applicants must submit an online application and provide the following materials: an application fee ($135 for US citizens/permanent residents; $155 for all others), Statement of Purpose, Personal History Statement, Curriculum Vitae (CV), a Writing Sample (must be double-spaced and no more than 30 pages), three letters of recommendation, and transcripts from each college or university attended. International applicants must also demonstrate English Language Proficiency via the TOEFL or IELTS. The Graduate Record Examination (GRE) is not required.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in African American Studies

Requirements: The Department of African American Studies at UC Berkeley offers a program of study leading to the Ph.D. degree (a terminal Master of Arts is not offered). Application requirements include a statement of purpose, personal statement, three letters of recommendation, a current resume or curriculum vitae, a writing sample (one, maximum of 25 pages), and transcripts. A minimum undergraduate GPA of 3.0 is required. The GRE General Test is not required.
Program name: Master of Arts in African American Studies

Requirements: Applicants must have a bachelor's degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution. A minimum Grade Point Average (GPA) of 3.0 is required. Application requirements include the submission of GRE General Test scores, three letters of recommendation, a Statement of Purpose, a Personal History Statement, and a current resume or curriculum vitae. International applicants whose native language is not English must also fulfill the English Language Proficiency requirement via the TOEFL or IELTS exam.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Agricultural and Resource Economics

Requirements: To be eligible for the Master of Analytics, applicants must have a bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution with a minimum GPA of 3.0. Required prerequisites include Linear Algebra, Calculus, Probability and Statistics, and Computer Programming (Python is preferred). The application requires a Resume or CV, Statement of Purpose, Personal History Statement, official transcripts, and three letters of recommendation. GRE/GMAT scores are not required. International applicants must meet English language proficiency requirements (TOEFL or IELTS).
Program name: Master of Analytics

Requirements: The Graduate Group in Ancient History and Mediterranean Archaeology (AHMA) at the University of California, Berkeley offers an interdisciplinary program leading to the PhD degree. It is composed of 30 faculty members from eight different Berkeley departments: Anthropology, Classics, History, History of Art, Near Eastern Studies, Italian Studies, Rhetoric and Philosophy. Applicants are expected to have a strong foundation in at least one of the fields of study represented in the Graduate Group and to have begun the study of the necessary ancient and modern languages. A minimum GPA of 3.0 is required for admission to the University of California, Berkeley.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Ancient History and Mediterranean Archaeology

Requirements: The minimum graduate admission requirements are: (1) A bachelor’s degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution; (2) A satisfactory scholastic average, usually a minimum grade-point average (GPA) of 3.0 (B) on a 4.0 scale; and (3) Enough undergraduate training to do graduate work in your chosen field. In addition to the University’s minimum requirements, the department requires: Three letters of recommendation, Personal Statement, Statement of Purpose, Current CV, and a Writing sample (1 required, 2 maximum).
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Anthropology

Requirements: Applicants for the doctoral program should have a bachelor's degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution. A strong background in mathematics is necessary. We normally require at least 15 semester units of upper-division mathematics, including at least one year of analysis (e.g., MATH 104 and MATH 105) and one semester of linear algebra (e.g., MATH 110).
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Applied Mathematics

Requirements: Applicants must hold a bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution and have a minimum grade point average (GPA) of 3.0. Required application materials include unofficial transcripts, three letters of recommendation, a Statement of Purpose, a Personal History Statement, and a resume/CV. The GRE General Test is not required and will not be considered for this program.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Applied Science and Technology

Requirements: The minimum graduate admission requirements are: (1) A bachelor’s degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution; (2) A satisfactory scholastic average, usually a minimum grade-point average (GPA) of 3.0 (B) on a 4.0 scale; and (3) Enough undergraduate training to do graduate work in your chosen field. Application materials include three letters of recommendation, a portfolio of design work, and a Personal History Statement.
Program name: Master of Architecture

Requirements: Admission requirements for the Master of Science (MS) in Architecture include a Statement of Purpose, a Personal History Statement, a Resume or Curriculum Vitae (CV), three letters of recommendation, and official transcripts from all post-secondary institutions attended. Additionally, a writing sample is required for all MS applicants, while a portfolio is considered optional. The GRE is not required for admission. Applicants must have a minimum Grade Point Average (GPA) of 3.0.
Program name: Master of Science in Architecture

Requirements: To apply for the Ph.D. in Architecture, applicants must submit the UC Berkeley Graduate Division online application, which includes an application fee, official transcripts, three letters of recommendation, a statement of purpose, a personal history statement, and a resume or curriculum vitae. A writing sample is specifically required for Ph.D. applicants. The GRE is not required for this program.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Architecture

Requirements: Applicants must hold a Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution. Applicants must have completed a minimum of 18 semester units of upper division studio art courses. The Graduate Division requires a minimum grade point average of 3.0. Applicants are expected to have a broad knowledge of art history and be prepared to participate in a demanding program of work and study. A portfolio of work is a major part of the application.
Program name: Master of Fine Arts in Art Practice

Requirements: The Group in Asian Studies welcomes applications for the M.A. degree from students with strong backgrounds in an Asian language and in the social sciences or humanities. Requirements for admission include: A Bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution. A GPA of 3.0 or better (on a 4.0 scale) in the last two years of undergraduate study. Demonstrated proficiency in an Asian language (usually at least two years of college-level study or equivalent). Three letters of recommendation. Statement of Purpose. Personal History Statement. CV. Writing Sample. TOEFL or IELTS scores for international applicants.
Program name: Master of Arts in Asian Studies

Requirements: The PhD program in South & Southeast Asian Studies is designed to provide students with a solid foundation in the languages, literatures, and cultures of South and Southeast Asia. The program is flexible and allows students to pursue a variety of research interests, including linguistics, literature, religion, philosophy, and history. Minimum requirements for admission include a bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution and a minimum GPA of 3.0.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Asian Studies

Requirements: The minimum graduate admission requirements are: A bachelor’s degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution; A satisfactory scholastic average, usually a minimum grade-point average (GPA) of 3.0 (B) on a 4.0 scale; and Enough undergraduate training to do graduate work in your chosen field. Background in physics and mathematics is required.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Astronomy

Requirements: The Department of Astronomy offers a program of graduate study leading to the degree of Doctor of Philosophy in Astrophysics. The program is designed to provide students with a broad knowledge of modern astrophysics and the techniques of astronomical research. Admission requirements include the Graduate Division Application, Transcript(s), Letters of Recommendation (3), Statement of Purpose, and Personal History Statement.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Astrophysics
Master of Science in Bioengineering

Requirements: The PhD in Bioengineering is a joint program offered by UC Berkeley and UC San Francisco (UCSF). Applicants must have a bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution. A minimum grade point average (GPA) of 3.0 is required. Required application materials include a Statement of Purpose, Personal History Statement, three letters of recommendation, and transcripts. The GRE General Test is not required for this program.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Bioengineering

Requirements: Applicants must have a bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution with a satisfactory scholastic average, usually a minimum grade-point average (GPA) of 3.0 (B). For the MA in Biostatistics, prerequisites include multivariable calculus (equivalent to Berkeley's Math 53) and linear algebra (equivalent to Berkeley's Math 54). Students are expected to have a strong background in mathematics.
Program name: Master of Arts in Biostatistics

Requirements: The PhD in Biostatistics is offered by the Interdepartmental Graduate Group in Biostatistics. It is intended for students with a background in mathematics and/or statistics who have a strong interest in biological and health sciences. Admission to the PhD program is based on a review of the applicant’s academic record, letters of recommendation, and personal statements. Applicants must have a strong background in mathematics and/or statistics.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Biostatistics

Requirements: Admission to the Full-time MBA Program is based on a combination of academic achievement, professional experience, and leadership potential. The GMAT or GRE is required for all applicants. Applicants must have a bachelor's degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution. Professional experience is not required but is strongly recommended.
Program name: Master of Business Administration

Requirements: The PhD Program application process is online. Required materials include a current resume or curriculum vitae, a Statement of Purpose, a Personal History Statement, three letters of recommendation, official transcripts from all post-secondary institutions attended, valid GMAT or GRE scores, and TOEFL or IELTS scores for international applicants. A nonrefundable application fee is also required.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Business Administration

Requirements: The M.S. and Ph.D. programs in Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering are designed to develop each student’s ability to conduct independent creative research. While the Ph.D. is the department’s primary emphasis, the M.S. degree is also offered. Minimum requirements for admission include a bachelor’s degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution; a satisfactory scholastic average, usually a minimum grade-point average (GPA) of 3.0 (B) on a 4.0 scale; and enough undergraduate training to do graduate work in your chosen field.
Program name: Master of Science in Chemical Engineering

Requirements: A complete application includes: Three letters of recommendation, official transcripts, Statement of Purpose, Personal History Statement, Current Resume/C.V., TOEFL/IELTS scores (if applicable).
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Chemical Engineering

Requirements: Applicants must have a bachelor’s degree in chemistry or a closely related field. Generally, it is required that applicants have a GPA of at least 3.0 (on a 4.0 scale). Evidence of English language proficiency for international applicants whose native language is not English. Three letters of recommendation are required.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Chemistry

Requirements: Admission to the MCP program is based on the following: An undergraduate degree from an accredited institution with a GPA of 3.0 or better; Three letters of recommendation; Statement of Purpose; Personal History Statement; Resume or curriculum vitae; and TOEFL/IELTS for international applicants. The GRE is not required for the Master of City Planning (MCP) program.
Program name: Master of City Planning

Requirements: The minimum graduate admission requirements are: (1) A bachelor’s degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution; (2) A satisfactory scholastic average, usually a minimum grade-point average (GPA) of 3.0 (B) on a 4.0 scale; and (3) Enough undergraduate training to do graduate work in your chosen field. Application materials for the Ph.D. in City and Regional Planning include three letters of recommendation, a Statement of Purpose, a Personal History Statement, a current Resume/CV, and a writing sample. For international applicants from countries where the official language is not English, TOEFL or IELTS scores are required. The GRE is not required for this program.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in City and Regional Planning

Requirements: Applicants must have a bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution. A satisfactory scholastic average, usually a minimum grade-point average (GPA) of 3.0 (B) on a 4.0 scale, is required. The GRE is not required for the application. As part of the online application, you will also be required to submit a Personal History Statement and three letters of recommendation.
Program name: Master of Engineering in Civil and Environmental Engineering

Requirements: A bachelor’s degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution; A satisfactory scholastic average, usually a minimum grade-point average (GPA) of 3.0 (B) on a 4.0 scale; Enough undergraduate training to do graduate work in your chosen field. Applicants must also provide three letters of recommendation, a Statement of Purpose, a Personal History Statement, and evidence of English language proficiency if their native language is not English.
Program name: Master of Science in Civil and Environmental Engineering

Requirements: Applicants must have at least a 3.0 or higher-level GPA from their undergraduate institution. Required application materials include unofficial transcripts, three letters of recommendation, a statement of purpose, a personal history statement, a resume/curriculum vitae, and evidence of English language proficiency (for international applicants). A bachelor's degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution is required.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Civil and Environmental Engineering

Requirements: To apply to the PhD program in Classics, applicants must submit an online application through the UC Berkeley Graduate Division. Requirements include a statement of purpose, a personal history statement, three letters of recommendation, official transcripts from all post-secondary institutions attended, a writing sample of roughly 20-25 pages, and a curriculum vitae (CV). The GRE is not required for applications to the PhD in Classics.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Classics

Requirements: Applicants must have a bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution with a minimum grade point average of B (3.0). Required preparation includes study in three literatures, at least one of which must be an ancient language, and command of at least two foreign languages, with at least one of these usually being at an advanced level. Admission is based on the applicant's academic record, statement of purpose, personal statement, three letters of recommendation, and a writing sample. The Graduate Record Examination (GRE) is not required.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Comparative Literature

Requirements: A minimum GPA of 3.0 is required. Applicants for the research-oriented degrees are usually required to have an undergraduate degree in a technical discipline. Admission to the MS and PhD programs is highly competitive. Applications are evaluated by a faculty committee that takes into account the applicant's academic record, research experience, and potential for success in a research-intensive environment. Required application materials include a Statement of Purpose, Personal History Statement, Resume or Curriculum Vitae, and three letters of recommendation.
Program name: Master of Science in Computer Science

Requirements: Applicants must have a bachelor's degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution with a minimum Grade Point Average (GPA) of 3.0. Required application materials include official transcripts, three letters of recommendation, a Statement of Purpose, a Personal History Statement, and a Resume/CV. The GRE (Graduate Record Examination) is not required for the Computer Science PhD program and will not be considered in the review process.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Computer Science

Requirements: Applicants must have a bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution. A minimum Grade Point Average (GPA) of 3.0 (B) on a 4.0 scale is required. International students from a country where the official language is not English must also fulfill the English Language Proficiency requirement.
Program name: Master of Design

Requirements: A bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution or recognized equivalent. Minimum Grade Point Average (GPA) of 3.0. Resume or Curriculum Vitae. Three letters of recommendation. Statement of Purpose. Personal History Statement. Transcripts. English Language Proficiency (TOEFL or IELTS) if applicable. The GRE is not required.
Program name: Master of Development Engineering

Requirements: To be eligible for the Berkeley MDP, an applicant must have a Bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution. A typical applicant has at least two years of work experience in a field related to international development. The application requires a completed online graduate application, official transcripts, three letters of recommendation, a current resume/CV, a Statement of Purpose, and a Personal History Statement. International applicants must provide evidence of English language proficiency (TOEFL or IELTS scores). The GRE is not required.
Program name: Master of Development Practice

Requirements: In addition to the University’s basic requirements for admission, the department requires three letters of recommendation and a statement of purpose. The GRE is not required. Completion of the PhD degree requires: 1) a minimum of four units of 200-level courses from four different EPS professors, 2) passing an oral qualifying examination, 3) the writing of a dissertation, and 4) a final public presentation of the research.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Earth and Planetary Science

Requirements: The Department of East Asian Languages and Cultures (EALC) offers a program of study in the languages and cultures of China, Japan, and Korea, leading to the PhD. Requirements for admission include a bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution, a minimum grade point average (GPA) of 3.0 (B) on a 4.0 scale, and evidence of English Language Proficiency for international applicants. The GRE is not required for this program.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in East Asian Languages and Cultures

Requirements: The Department of Economics requires that applicants have a basic knowledge of undergraduate economics: at least one course in intermediate microeconomics, one course in intermediate macroeconomics, and one course in econometrics. We also require a strong mathematical background: at least two years of calculus, one course in linear algebra, and one course in statistics. The minimum graduate admission requirements are: A bachelor’s degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution; A satisfactory scholastic average, usually a minimum grade-point average (GPA) of 3.0 (B) on a 4.0 scale; and enough undergraduate training to do graduate work in your chosen field.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Economics

Requirements: The minimum graduate admission requirements are: (1) A bachelor’s degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution; (2) A satisfactory scholastic average, usually a minimum grade-point average (GPA) of 3.0 (B) on a 4.0 scale; and (3) Enough undergraduate training to do graduate work in your chosen field. Required application materials include an online application, application fee, transcripts, three letters of recommendation, statement of purpose, personal history statement, and a resume/CV.
Program name: Master of Arts in Education

Requirements: In addition to the University’s requirements for admission, applicants to the Berkeley School of Education must fulfill the following: 1. A Statement of Purpose 2. A Personal History Statement 3. Three letters of recommendation 4. Official transcripts for all college-level work 5. A current resume or curriculum vitae 6. A writing sample. The GRE is not required for the PhD in Education.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Education

Requirements: Requirements for admission to the LEAD EdD program include: A Master's degree from an accredited institution; A grade point average of at least 3.0 (B) or better; Evidence of professional leadership in education or a related field; Professional writing sample; Current CV/Resume; Three letters of recommendation; Statement of Purpose; and a Personal History Statement. GRE scores are not required for this program.
Program name: Doctor of Education in Education

Requirements: The minimum graduate admission requirements are: (1) A bachelor’s degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution; (2) A satisfactory scholastic average, usually a minimum grade-point average (GPA) of 3.0 (B) on a 4.0 scale; and (3) Enough undergraduate training to do graduate work in your chosen field. Applicants must also provide three letters of recommendation, a Statement of Purpose, a Personal History Statement, and unofficial transcripts. The GRE is not required for the M.Eng. program.
Program name: Master of Engineering in Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences

Requirements: The minimum undergraduate grade point average (GPA) for admission is 3.0 (B) on a 4.0 scale. Applicants must submit a Statement of Purpose, a Personal History Statement, three letters of recommendation, and a current resume or curriculum vitae. The GRE is not required.
Program name: Master of Science in Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences

Requirements: In addition to the University’s minimum requirements, applicants must also meet the specific requirements of the EECS Department. A minimum grade point average of 3.0 (B) or better is required. The Graduate Record Examination (GRE) is not required for the PhD, MS/PhD, and MS program applications. International applicants from countries in which the official language is not English and who do not hold a bachelor's degree from a US institution must provide evidence of English language proficiency.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences

Requirements: The Graduate Group in Energy and Resources (ERG) offers two programs of study and research: one leading to the MA and MS degrees in Energy and Resources, and the other to the PhD degree in Energy and Resources. The objective of the program is to teach students the range of knowledge and the types of analysis they will need to understand and help solve the world’s energy and resource problems. To that end, the ERG curriculum is designed to provide students with a fundamental understanding of the biological, physical, economic, and political-institutional dimensions of energy and resource issues.
Program name: Master of Arts in Energy and Resources

Requirements: A bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution. Evidence of academic excellence and potential for creative research. A minimum GPA of 3.0 is required. The GRE General Test is not required and will not be considered. International applicants must demonstrate English proficiency via the TOEFL or IELTS.
Program name: Master of Science in Energy and Resources

Requirements: In addition to the University’s minimum requirements, the Group requires that an applicant have a strong background in one of the relevant fields, such as physical, biological or social sciences, engineering or humanities. Applicants should have a minimum of two semesters of college-level calculus and at least one semester of upper-division natural science or engineering. The requirements for the Ph.D. consist of coursework, a preliminary examination, a qualifying examination, and a dissertation. Ph.D. applicants are usually expected to have already completed a master's degree or equivalent.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Energy and Resources

Requirements: Each applicant must have a B.A. or its equivalent from an institution of acceptable standing. In addition, we require that applicants have done a substantial amount of work in English literature. It is also important that an applicant be able to demonstrate an ability to read at least one foreign language. Materials for the online application include: Letters of recommendation, GRE scores (General and Subject), Transcripts, Writing Sample, Statement of Purpose, and Personal Statement.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in English

Requirements: Applicants to the MS program must have: A bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution. Evidence of potential for doctoral study. A minimum of one year of prior research experience is strongly recommended. Preference is given to applicants with strong backgrounds in the biological or physical sciences. Previous coursework should include: 1 year of general chemistry, 1 year of biology, and at least 1 semester of organic chemistry.
Program name: Master of Science in Environmental Health Sciences

Requirements: The program in Environmental Health Sciences (EHS) provides students with the knowledge and skills for research and leadership in the field of environmental health. Applicants are required to submit a Statement of Purpose, a Personal History Statement, a Resumé/Curriculum Vitae, three Letters of Recommendation, and Transcripts for all college-level work. Applicants must have an academic record of high quality and demonstrate commitment to the field of public health. A bachelor’s degree or its recognized equivalent from an accredited institution is required for admission. The GRE General Test is not required.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Environmental Health Sciences

Requirements: Applicants must complete an online application and submit a Statement of Purpose (2-3 pages), a Personal History Statement, three letters of recommendation, unofficial transcripts from each institution attended, and a current CV or resume. A minimum GPA of 3.0 from the undergraduate institution is required. International applicants must also meet the Graduate Division’s English Language Proficiency requirement. The GRE is not required and will not be seen by the admissions committee.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Environmental Science, Policy, and Management

Requirements: Applicants must have a bachelor’s degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution. A minimum grade-point average of 3.0 (B) is required. At least one college-level math or statistics course with a grade of B or better is required. The GRE is not required.
Program name: Master of Science in Epidemiology

Requirements: Applicants must have a previous degree (BA, BS, MA, MS, MPH, MD, or equivalent) and an interest in and a demonstrated aptitude for quantitative methods and research. Successful applicants generally have a background in a related field (such as biology, math, statistics, or social sciences) and previous research or work experience in public health or a related area. While a prior master’s degree is not strictly required for the PhD program, most successful applicants do have one.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Epidemiology

Requirements: A bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution. A grade point average (GPA) of at least 3.0 (B) is required for the application to be reviewed. Applicants must submit a Statement of Purpose, a Personal History Statement, three letters of recommendation, a writing sample (approx. 30 pages maximum), and a current resume or CV. The GRE is not required for the 2024-2025 application cycle.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Ethnic Studies

Requirements: The PhD in Film & Media is a 12-course program (plus two semesters of Graduate Student Instructor pedagogy courses). PhD students are expected to complete two years of coursework, followed by a Qualifying Exam in the third year and a doctoral dissertation thereafter. Applicants must hold a BA or equivalent from an accredited institution. An MA is not required to apply.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Film and Media

Requirements: To be considered for admission to the MFE Program, you must have a bachelor's degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution. Applicants must demonstrate a strong quantitative background including coursework in Multivariate Calculus, Linear Algebra, Differential Equations, Numerical Analysis, and Statistics and Probability. Proficiency in computer programming, specifically Python and C++, is required prior to the start of the program. Applicants must also provide valid GRE or GMAT scores, a professional resume, and two letters of recommendation.
Program name: Master of Financial Engineering

Requirements: The basic requirements for admission to the Folklore M.A. program are: 1. A Bachelor of Arts or Bachelor of Science degree from an accredited institution. 2. An undergraduate Grade Point Average of 3.0 or higher. 3. Proficiency in at least one foreign language is required for the M.A. degree in Folklore. This requirement may be satisfied by the end of the first year of the program.
Program name: Master of Arts in Folklore

Requirements: To apply for the Ph.D. program in French, applicants must submit the University’s Graduate Application. Required materials include: 1. Statement of Purpose: approximately 2 pages in English, describing preparation and motivation for graduate study. 2. Personal History Statement: in English. 3. Transcripts: Digital transcripts from each college or university attended. 4. Three letters of recommendation. 5. Writing Sample: 20-25 pages in length in French or English, demonstrating best scholarly work. The GRE is not required. Applicants must have a B.A. or M.A. in French or its equivalent from a university of recognized standing.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in French

Requirements: To apply to the graduate program, applicants must submit a complete application through the UC Berkeley Graduate Division online application system. A complete application includes: Statement of Purpose, Personal History Statement, Transcripts from all post-secondary institutions attended, Three letters of recommendation (submitted through the online application system), a Writing Sample (15–30 pages), and a Curriculum Vitae or Resume. International applicants must also submit TOEFL or IELTS scores. The Geography Department no longer requires the GRE.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Geography

Requirements: Applicants for the Ph.D. in German at UC Berkeley must submit an online application that includes a Statement of Purpose, a Personal History Statement, a Writing Sample (approximately 20-25 pages in German or English), three letters of recommendation, and a CV/Resume. Applicants must also provide transcripts from all institutions of higher education attended. The GRE (Graduate Record Examination) is not required for admission to this program.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in German

Requirements: To apply for the Master of Arts in Global Studies, you will need to submit the following: Official Transcripts, Evidence of English Language Proficiency, Statement of Purpose, Personal History Statement, A current CV, Three letters of recommendation. Analytical Writing Sample (Optional), GRE scores (Optional).
Program name: Master of Arts in Global Studies

Requirements: Applicants must have a bachelor’s degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution, a satisfactory scholastic average (usually a minimum GPA of 3.0), and enough undergraduate training to do graduate work in the chosen field. Required application materials include a Statement of Purpose, Personal History Statement, three letters of recommendation, transcripts, a current Resume/CV, and a Writing Sample. The GRE is not required for this program.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Health Policy

Requirements: To apply for the Ph.D. in Hispanic Languages and Literatures, applicants must submit a Graduate Division online application, official transcripts from all institutions attended after high school, three letters of recommendation, a Statement of Purpose, a Personal History Statement, a curriculum vitae (CV), and a writing sample of approximately 15-20 pages in Spanish or Portuguese. The GRE is not required for admission to this program.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Hispanic Languages and Literatures

Requirements: Applicants must hold a bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution and have a minimum grade point average (GPA) of 3.0. Required application materials include a Statement of Purpose, a Personal History Statement, a curriculum vitae (CV), three letters of recommendation, and a writing sample. The GRE is no longer required for admission to the PhD program in History.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in History

Requirements: Application components: Statement of Purpose; Personal History Statement; Curriculum Vitae; Three letters of recommendation; A writing sample (e.g. a term paper, or a portion of a senior or master’s thesis) of 15 to 25 pages, but no more than 30 pages; Transcripts of all college or university work. The Graduate Record Examination (GRE) is no longer required for application to the Ph.D. program in History of Art.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in History of Art

Requirements: Applicants must fulfill the following: A bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution; A minimum grade point average (GPA) of 3.0 (B) on a 4.0 scale; Three letters of recommendation; Statement of Purpose; Personal History Statement; Resume; Evidence of English language proficiency (TOEFL or IELTS) if the applicant’s degree is from a country where English is not the official language.
Program name: Master of Engineering in Industrial Engineering and Operations Research

Requirements: Applicants to the M.S. and Ph.D. programs must have a bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution. A major in engineering, physical science, mathematics, or another field with a strong mathematical background is preferred. The department requires a minimum Grade Point Average (GPA) of 3.0 or higher for the last two years of undergraduate study. Required application materials include transcripts, three letters of recommendation, a statement of purpose, a personal history statement, and a resume/CV.
Program name: Master of Science in Industrial Engineering and Operations Research

Requirements: To be eligible for admission to the IEOR graduate program, you must have a bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution or its equivalent. A minimum grade point average (GPA) of 3.0 is required. Applicants are also expected to have a strong mathematical background, including calculus, linear algebra, and probability and statistics. The IEOR department welcomes applications from students with strong backgrounds in any area of engineering, mathematics, physics, or other quantitative sciences.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Industrial Engineering and Operations Research

Requirements: Applicants must have a bachelor’s degree or its recognized equivalent from an accredited institution. A high level of technical aptitude and a basic proficiency in at least one programming language (such as Python, Java, or C++) are required for success in the program. Applicants are also required to submit three letters of recommendation, a statement of purpose, and a personal history statement.
Program name: Master of Information and Cybersecurity

Requirements: The Master of Information and Data Science (MIDS) program is an innovative part-time program that prepares data science professionals to solve real-world problems. Applicants must have a superior scholastic record, normally a 3.0 undergraduate GPA. Applicants should have a working knowledge of fundamental programming concepts and a basic understanding of data structures and algorithms, and they should have completed a college-level course in introductory statistics.
Program name: Master of Information and Data Science

Requirements: Bachelor’s degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution. A minimum Grade Point Average (GPA) of 3.0 (B) on a 4.0 scale. 3 Letters of Recommendation. Statement of Purpose. Personal History Statement. Evidence of English Language Proficiency (for international applicants). High level of quantitative and analytical ability. Basic understanding of programming and data structures.
Program name: Master of Information Management and Systems

Requirements: Applicants must hold a bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution. To apply, you must submit the UC Berkeley Graduate Division online application. Required application materials include: UC Berkeley graduate application, Application fee, Current Resume or Curriculum Vitae (CV), Three letters of recommendation, Statement of purpose, Personal history statement, Transcripts from all college-level institutions attended, TOEFL or IELTS scores (for international applicants from countries where the official language is not English), and a Writing sample.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Information Management and Systems

Requirements: Applicants must have a bachelor's degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution. Applicants should have a minimum GPA of 3.0. A complete application consists of the following: University Online Application, Three letters of recommendation, Statement of Purpose, Personal History Statement, Resume/CV, Official transcripts (uploaded), TOEFL/IELTS scores (if applicable). The GRE General and Subject tests are no longer required for admission to the IB graduate program.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Integrative Biology

Requirements: The department admits students for the fall semester only. Applicants are required to have a bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution. A background in Italian literature and culture is expected. Minimum requirements for admission include: 1. A bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution. 2. A minimum grade point average of 3.0 (B) on a 4.0 scale. 3. Sufficient undergraduate training to undertake graduate study in Italian. 4. Evidence of English language proficiency, if your native language is not English and you have not received a degree from a university in an English-speaking country.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Italian Studies

Requirements: Applicants must have a bachelor's degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution with a grade point average (GPA) of at least 3.0 (B). Required application materials include a statement of purpose, personal history statement, resume/CV, three letters of recommendation, and three samples of journalistic work. International applicants must also meet the Graduate Division's requirements for English language proficiency (TOEFL or IELTS). The GRE is not required for applicants to the MJ program.
Program name: Master of Journalism

Requirements: The Jurisprudence and Social Policy (JSP) program at UC Berkeley requires applicants to submit a Statement of Purpose, a Personal History Statement, three letters of recommendation, and a writing sample (preferably 10 to 20 pages). A Curriculum Vitae (CV) or Resume is also required. Standardized tests, such as the GRE, are not required for admission to this program. Applicants should have a background in social sciences or humanities.
Program name: Master of Arts in Jurisprudence and Social Policy

Requirements: Applicants must hold a bachelor's degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution. Application requirements include the University’s online Graduate Application, official transcripts from all institutions attended after high school, three letters of recommendation, a Statement of Purpose, a Personal History Statement, and a Writing Sample. The JSP Program no longer requires or accepts GRE scores as part of the application for admission.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Jurisprudence and Social Policy

Requirements: Applicants must meet the general requirements for admission to the Graduate Division at UC Berkeley, including a bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution and a minimum grade point average of 3.0 (B). Applicants to the MLA program will be required to submit transcripts from all higher education institutions attended, three letters of recommendation, a Statement of Purpose, a Personal History Statement, and a portfolio of creative work.
Program name: Master of Landscape Architecture

Requirements: Applicants are expected to have completed a master's degree before entering the Ph.D. program. However, students with only a bachelor's degree may be admitted under exceptional circumstances. The Ph.D. program in Landscape Architecture and Environmental Planning is for students who wish to pursue research and teaching careers. The program is designed to provide students with a strong foundation in the theoretical and methodological aspects of the field, while also allowing them the flexibility to pursue their own research interests.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Landscape Architecture and Environmental Planning

Requirements: Applicants for admission must have an undergraduate major in Latin or the equivalent. The minimum graduate admission requirements are: (1) A bachelor’s degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution; (2) A satisfactory scholastic average, usually a minimum grade-point average (GPA) of 3.0 (B) on a 4.0 scale; and (3) Enough undergraduate training to do graduate work in your chosen field. Three letters of recommendation are required.
Program name: Master of Arts in Latin
Doctor of Philosophy in Latin American Studies

Requirements: To be eligible for the LL.M. program, applicants must have a first degree in law (JD, LLB, or equivalent) from a law school outside the US or an ABA-accredited law school in the US. Applicants must submit an online application through LSAC, an application fee, official transcripts, at least two letters of recommendation, a personal statement, and a curriculum vitae (CV) or resume. Additionally, applicants whose first degree in law was not taught in English must provide a TOEFL or IELTS score.
Program name: Master of Laws

Requirements: The J.S.D. is Berkeley Law’s most advanced law degree. It is designed for those interested in academia and requires a high degree of independent research and writing. The program is limited to a small number of exceptional students who have already completed an LL.M. degree. All applicants must have already completed (or be in the final year of) an LL.M. degree at Berkeley Law or a similarly high-ranked law school in the U.S. or another common-law country. Application materials include: an Online LSAC application, application fee, Curriculum Vitae, Personal Statement (2-3 pages), Dissertation Proposal, Writing Sample (in English), Two Letters of Recommendation (three are preferred), Transcripts/Academic Records, and English Language Proficiency.
Program name: Doctor of Juridical Science

Requirements: Applicants must have a bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution. All applicants are required to take the Law School Admission Test (LSAT) or the Graduate Record Exam (GRE). Application components include a personal statement, a current resume, and two letters of recommendation. Applicants must also register with the Law School Admission Council (LSAC) Credential Assembly Service (CAS).
Program name: Juris Doctor

Requirements: Applicants to the graduate program in linguistics must have a bachelor's degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution. A previous degree in linguistics is not required, but applicants should have a clear idea of why they want to pursue graduate study in the field. Selection is based on the applicant's prior academic record, letters of recommendation, statement of purpose, and a sample of written work.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Linguistics

Requirements: To apply for the Doctor of Philosophy in Logic and the Methodology of Science, applicants must have a bachelor's degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution with a minimum GPA of 3.0. Required application materials include three letters of recommendation, official transcripts from all institutions attended after high school, a statement of purpose, a personal history statement, a curriculum vitae, and a writing sample. The GRE General Test is not required for admission to this program.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Logic and the Methodology of Science

Requirements: The Master of Engineering (M.Eng.) program is designed for students who want to develop their technical expertise while also gaining business and leadership skills. This degree is intended for students who want to work in industry after graduation. Applicants must have a bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution, a minimum GPA of 3.0, and a background in a physical science or engineering.
Program name: Master of Engineering in Materials Science and Engineering

Requirements: To be considered for admission, applicants must have a bachelor's degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution and a minimum grade point average (GPA) of 3.0 (B) on a 4.0 scale. Required application materials include: Evidence of English Language Proficiency, three letters of recommendation, a Statement of Purpose, a Personal History Statement, and a Resume/CV. The GRE is not required.
Program name: Master of Science in Materials Science and Engineering

Requirements: A bachelor’s degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution. The Graduate Division requires a minimum grade-point average (GPA) of 3.0 (B) or better. The Department of Materials Science and Engineering requires that all applicants have a minimum 3.0 GPA. Evidence of English language proficiency, if your native language is not English, is also required. Required documents include: Statement of purpose, Personal history statement, three letters of recommendation, official transcripts, and a current CV. GRE: Not required.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Materials Science and Engineering

Requirements: Applicants are expected to have a solid background in mathematics. Most successful applicants have taken some or all of the following upper division courses: real and complex analysis, abstract algebra, linear algebra, topology and differential geometry. The following items must be submitted via the online application: 1. Statement of Purpose: Describe your aptitude and motivation for graduate study in your area of specialization, including your preparation for this field of study, your academic plans or research interests, and your future career goals. 2. Personal History Statement: Describe how your personal background informs your decision to pursue a graduate degree. 3. Three letters of recommendation: These should be submitted via the online application. 4. Transcripts: Upload copies of transcripts for all college-level coursework. 5. GRE Scores: The GRE General Test and the GRE Mathematics Subject Test are required. 6. TOEFL/IELTS scores: If you have completed at least one year of full-time academic course work with grades of B or better at a recognized U.S. institution, you do not need to take a standardized test. Instead, you must upload an unofficial transcript from the U.S. institution.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Mathematics

Requirements: Applicants must hold a bachelor’s degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution and have a minimum Grade Point Average (GPA) of 3.0. Application requirements include undergraduate transcripts, three letters of recommendation, a Statement of Purpose, a Personal History Statement, and a current resume or CV. For the Master of Engineering in Mechanical Engineering, the GRE is not required for the current application cycle. International applicants must also demonstrate English language proficiency through the TOEFL or IELTS exams.
Program name: Master of Engineering in Mechanical Engineering

Requirements: The minimum graduate admission requirements are: (1) A bachelor’s degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution; (2) A satisfactory scholastic average, usually a minimum grade-point average (GPA) of 3.0 (B) on a 4.0 scale; and (3) Enough undergraduate training to do graduate work in your chosen field. Applicants must also provide three letters of recommendation, a Statement of Purpose, a Personal History Statement, and a current Resume/CV.
Program name: Master of Science in Mechanical Engineering

Requirements: To apply for the Doctor of Philosophy in Mechanical Engineering at UC Berkeley, applicants must have a Bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution with a minimum grade point average (GPA) of 3.0 (B) on a 4.0 scale. Required application materials include an online application, official transcripts, three letters of recommendation, a statement of purpose, a personal history statement, and a current resume. For international applicants, evidence of English Language Proficiency (TOEFL or IELTS) is required. The General Record Examination (GRE) is not required for the current application cycle.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Mechanical Engineering
Master of Arts in Media Studies

Requirements: The Department of Anthropology admits students for the PhD degree only. Our program is for students who intend to pursue a career in research and teaching. We do not have a Master’s degree program. We also have a Joint Program in Medical Anthropology (PhD) with the University of California, San Francisco (UCSF). Applications for the Medical Anthropology program are only accepted in even-numbered years (e.g., 2024, 2026, etc.) to UC Berkeley and in odd-numbered years (e.g., 2023, 2025, etc.) to UC San Francisco. Basic requirements include the Online Graduate Application, Statement of Purpose, Personal History Statement, Transcripts, Letters of Recommendation (3), Writing Sample, and Resume/Curriculum Vitae.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Medical Anthropology

Requirements: Online application to the Graduate Division; Transcript (official or unofficial) from each college or university attended; Graduate Record Exam (GRE): GRE scores are NOT required for the Metabolic Biology MS or PhD application; Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL) or International English Language Testing System (IELTS) (if applicable); Three Letters of Recommendation; Resume/CV; Statement of Purpose; Personal History Statement; Application Fee.
Program name: Master of Science in Metabolic Biology

Requirements: Graduate applicants are first reviewed by the faculty in the Graduate Program in Metabolic Biology. Students with a background in nutrition, biology, and/or chemistry are encouraged to apply. Prerequisites: 1 year general chemistry with lab, 1 year organic chemistry with lab, 1 semester biochemistry, 1 semester physiology, 1 semester molecular biology.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Metabolic Biology

Requirements: Basic requirements for admission include: (1) A bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution. (2) A minimum grade-point average (GPA) of 3.0 (B) on a 4.0 scale. (3) Background in the biological and physical sciences. GRE scores are NOT required for applicants to our graduate programs. International students must also demonstrate English proficiency through TOEFL or IELTS exams.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Microbiology

Requirements: Applicants must meet the minimum graduate admission requirements of the University of California, Berkeley. These include a bachelor's degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution and a minimum grade point average (GPA) of 3.0. The program requires three letters of recommendation, official transcripts, a Statement of Purpose, and a Personal History Statement. Applicants must also provide a writing sample and a Resume/Curriculum Vitae. The Graduate Record Examination (GRE) is not required for admission to this program.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Middle Eastern Studies

Requirements: Applicants must have a bachelor’s degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution and a minimum grade-point average (GPA) of 3.0. A strong background in biology, chemistry, and mathematics is expected. The GRE General Test is no longer required and will not be considered for admission. Required application materials include a Statement of Purpose, a Personal History Statement, a Curriculum Vitae (CV), and three letters of recommendation.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Molecular and Cell Biology

Requirements: The Penn State Graduate School requires: Complete Penn State Graduate School application, TOEFL or IELTS scores (if applicable), and official transcripts. The Master of Arts in Music (MA) specifically requires: GPA of 3.0 or higher, three letters of recommendation, a resume, Statement of Purpose, and writing sample (or samples).
Program name: Master of Arts in Music

Requirements: Admission to the PhD in Music at UC Berkeley requires a bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution, or its equivalent, with a grade-point average (GPA) of at least 3.0. Applicants should have a background in music equivalent to the music major at UC Berkeley. Required application materials include official transcripts, three letters of recommendation, a Statement of Purpose, a Personal History Statement, and a Curriculum Vitae (CV). For applicants in the scholarship tracks (Musicology and Ethnomusicology), recent writing samples are required. For applicants in the Composition track, three scores and recordings of their music are required. The GRE is not required for admission.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Music

Requirements: Applications are considered once a year for the fall semester only. Applicants for admission to the doctoral program should have a bachelor's degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution. Although a master's degree is not required, applicants with an MA in the field or a related one are given preference. Students should have a reading knowledge of at least one of the languages in their field of concentration (Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, or Turkish; or ancient Near Eastern languages, such as Akkadian, Egyptian, or Sumerian). Additional requirements: Three letters of recommendation, Current CV, Statement of Purpose, Personal History Statement, Writing sample (not to exceed 30 pages).
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Near Eastern Studies

Requirements: The minimum graduate admission requirements are: A bachelor’s degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution; A satisfactory scholastic average, usually a minimum grade-point average (GPA) of 3.0 (B) on a 4.0 scale; and Enough undergraduate training to do graduate work in your chosen field.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Neuroscience

Requirements: In addition to the University’s basic requirements for admission, the department requires a basic background in physics and mathematics, including calculus and differential equations. An undergraduate degree in engineering, physics, or mathematics is recommended.
Program name: Master of Engineering in Nuclear Engineering

Requirements: The minimum requirement for admission to graduate study in the Department of Nuclear Engineering is a bachelor’s degree in engineering, physics, chemistry, or mathematics from an accredited institution. Applicants must have a grade point average of at least 3.0 (B) for the last two years of undergraduate study. The department also requires three letters of recommendation, a Statement of Purpose, and a Personal History Statement.
Program name: Master of Science in Nuclear Engineering

Requirements: A bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution. A minimum grade point average (GPA) of 3.0 (B) on a 4.0 scale. To apply, submit the UC Berkeley Graduate Division online application. Required documents include: official transcripts, three letters of recommendation, a statement of purpose, and a personal history statement. Applicants for admission to the graduate program in Nuclear Engineering are expected to have completed an undergraduate program in physical science or engineering.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Nuclear Engineering

Requirements: The Department of Nutritional Sciences and Toxicology (NST) requires applicants to have had sufficient undergraduate preparation in chemistry (organic and physical) and biology (including molecular biology and biochemistry). Applicants are required to have a Bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution and a minimum grade point average of B (3.0) or better.
Program name: Master of Science in Nutritional Sciences and Toxicology

Requirements: Applicants for the Ph.D. in Nutritional Sciences and Toxicology must have a bachelor's degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution with a minimum GPA of 3.0. Required prerequisite coursework includes General Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biology, Physiology, Calculus, and Statistics. The application requires a Statement of Purpose, a Personal History Statement, a Resume/CV, and three letters of recommendation. The Graduate Record Examination (GRE) is not required for admission to this program.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Nutritional Sciences and Toxicology

Requirements: To be considered for admission to the UC Berkeley School of Optometry, you must: Have a minimum overall 3.00 GPA (on a 4.00 scale) for all college coursework; Complete the required prerequisite courses; Take the OAT (Optometry Admission Test); Demonstrate your potential through a variety of experiences; Submit three letters of recommendation; Provide a personal statement; Complete the online application and pay the application fee.
Program name: Doctor of Optometry

Requirements: Admission to the Ph.D. program in Performance Studies is highly selective. Successful applicants have strong academic backgrounds and demonstrate an interest in the study of performance as a central site of social and cultural life. Students with undergraduate or Master’s degrees in any relevant field are encouraged to apply.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Performance Studies

Requirements: In addition to the University’s Academic Requirements, applicants must also meet the following program requirements: A writing sample (not to exceed 20 pages) is required. A statement of purpose and a personal statement are required. Three letters of recommendation are required. Current Resume or Curriculum Vitae. For fall 2025, the GRE is not required.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Philosophy

Requirements: The UC Berkeley Physics Department graduate program is designed for students who are interested in pursuing a Ph.D. The department does not offer a separate M.A. degree. The Ph.D. program is intended to prepare students for careers in research and teaching. The following list of items is required for the application: 1. Resume/CV, 2. Personal Statement, 3. Three Letters of Recommendation, 4. Transcripts, 5. Statement of Purpose, 6. The TOEFL or the IELTS (International Students only). We no longer require or accept GRE scores (General and Subject). These scores will not be considered if submitted.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Physics

Requirements: Applicants should have a strong background in the biological, chemical, or physical sciences. A minimum 3.0 grade point average is required. Undergraduate preparation should include a minimum of one year each of biology, organic chemistry, and physics, and at least one semester of calculus. Required application materials include an online application, Statement of Purpose, Personal History Statement, transcripts, three letters of recommendation, and a current CV. The GRE General Test is not required and will not be considered for admission.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Plant Biology

Requirements: The minimum graduate admission requirements are: (1) A bachelor’s degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution; (2) A satisfactory scholastic average, usually a minimum grade-point average (GPA) of 3.0 (B) on a 4.0 scale; and (3) Enough undergraduate training to do graduate work in your chosen field. The Department of Political Science requires a Statement of Purpose, Personal History Statement, 3 Letters of Recommendation, Official Transcripts, Resume/Curriculum Vitae, and a Writing Sample (one writing sample, no more than 30 pages). The GRE is not required.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Political Science

Requirements: Applicants must have a bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution and a minimum grade-point average (GPA) of 3.0. Required application materials include a Statement of Purpose, Personal History Statement, Curriculum Vitae (CV), three letters of recommendation, and transcripts. The GRE General Test and GRE Subject Test are no longer required for admission to this program.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Psychology

Requirements: The minimum graduate admission requirements are: (1) A bachelor’s degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution; (2) A satisfactory scholastic average, usually a minimum grade-point average (GPA) of 3.0 (B) on a 4.0 scale; and (3) Enough undergraduate training to do graduate work in your chosen field. The School of Public Health also requires three letters of recommendation and a current CV or resume. Specific concentrations within the MPH may have additional prerequisite coursework or work experience requirements.
Program name: Master of Public Health

Requirements: Applicants must have a bachelor’s degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution and a satisfactory scholastic average, usually a minimum grade-point average (GPA) of 3.0 (B) on a 4.0 scale. Required application materials include three letters of recommendation, a Statement of Purpose, a Personal History Statement, and a current CV or resume. Evidence of English language proficiency is required for international applicants. The GRE is not required for any graduate programs in Public Health.
Program name: Master of Science in Public Health

Requirements: Applicants must meet the University of California, Berkeley Graduate Division minimum requirements, which include a bachelor's degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution and a minimum grade point average (GPA) of 3.0. For the PhD in Public Health, applicants are generally expected to have completed a master's degree in a relevant field, though exceptional candidates with only a bachelor's degree may be considered. Required application materials include the online Graduate Application, Statement of Purpose, Personal History Statement, Resume or Curriculum Vitae, three letters of recommendation, and unofficial transcripts from all post-secondary institutions attended. International applicants must also meet the English Language Proficiency requirement.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Public Health

Requirements: Applicants to the DrPH program must have a minimum of 2 years of post-degree, full-time professional experience at the time of application. In addition, an MPH or other health-related master’s or doctoral degree (e.g., MA, MS, MPP, PhD, MD, JD) is required. Completion of MPH core coursework is recommended prior to matriculation into the DrPH program.
Program name: Doctor of Public Health

Requirements: The Goldman School of Public Policy (GSPP) requires all applicants to submit an online application, three letters of recommendation, a professional resume, two required essays, and official transcripts from all colleges and universities attended since high school. Applicants must have a bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution.
Program name: Master of Public Policy

Requirements: Applicants to the doctoral program must have completed a Master's degree in public policy or a related field (e.g., economics, political science, sociology, etc.). Doctoral program applicants who do not have a Master's degree in public policy or a related field are occasionally admitted, but they are generally required to complete the first year of the GSPP MPP program before beginning the PhD program course requirements.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Public Policy

Requirements: Minimum requirements for admission: A bachelor’s degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution; A satisfactory scholastic record, usually a minimum grade-point average (GPA) of 3.0 (B) on a 4.0 scale; Enough undergraduate training to do graduate work in your chosen field. Additional Program Requirements: Letters of Recommendation (3), Statement of Purpose, Personal History Statement, Resume/CV. The GRE General Test is not required.
Program name: Master of Science in Range Management

Requirements: Applicants must hold a bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution with a minimum grade point average (GPA) of 3.0. Application requirements include an online application, official transcripts, a Statement of Purpose, a Personal History Statement, three letters of recommendation, and a current resume. International applicants from countries where the official language is not English must submit evidence of English language proficiency (TOEFL or IELTS).
Program name: Master of Real Estate Development + Design

Requirements: Application requirements for the Doctor of Philosophy in Rhetoric include: Official transcripts, Three letters of recommendation, Statement of purpose, Personal history statement, Writing sample (approximately 20–30 pages), and a Resume/CV. The Rhetoric department is a leading center for the study of the history and theory of rhetoric in its diverse forms: through legal and political arguments, in the literary and the visual arts, and as a philosophical and ethical practice.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Rhetoric

Requirements: The Romance Languages and Literatures (RLL) program at UC Berkeley is a joint program that allows students to specialize in two or more Romance languages (French, Italian, and Spanish) and their literatures. Minimum requirements for admission include a bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution, and a grade point average of at least 3.0 (B). The RLL program requires its students to be proficient in at least two Romance languages. At least one of these should be at the level of a native speaker or a student with an undergraduate major in that language/literature. To be admitted, you should have at least some knowledge of the second language. Knowledge of a third Romance language is desirable, though not required for admission.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Romance Languages and Literatures

Requirements: Applicants must have a bachelor’s degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution and a minimum grade-point average (GPA) of 3.0. Required application materials include three letters of recommendation, a Statement of Purpose, a Personal History Statement, a writing sample (typically 15-20 pages), and a current CV/resume.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Scandinavian Languages and Literatures

Requirements: Prospective applicants must have an undergraduate degree from an accredited institution. At least two years of Russian or another Slavic language are required for admission to the program. Applicants must have a grade point average of at least 3.0 (B) or the equivalent in all work completed after the first two years of undergraduate study. The department requires three letters of recommendation and a writing sample of 15–20 pages. Applicants must also provide a Statement of Purpose and a Personal History Statement.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Slavic Languages and Literatures

Requirements: To be considered for admission to the MSW program, you must meet the following minimum requirements: A bachelor's degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution. A grade point average (GPA) of B (3.0) or better. Evidence of sufficient preparation in the liberal arts and sciences. Social Work Experience: We strongly recommend that all applicants have the equivalent of at least one year (2,100 hours) of paid or volunteer social work experience.
Program name: Master of Social Welfare

Requirements: Applicants to the PhD program in Social Welfare must meet the following minimum requirements: a bachelor's degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution; a grade point average (GPA) of B (3.0) or better; evidence of capacity for doctoral-level scholarship and potential for making a significant contribution to the field of social welfare; and for most applicants, completion of a master's degree in social work or a related field. Required application materials include: Three letters of recommendation, Statement of Purpose, Personal History Statement, Writing Sample, and a Current Curriculum Vitae (CV) or Resume.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Social Welfare

Requirements: The basic minimum requirement for admission to graduate study at Berkeley is a bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution with a 3.0 grade-point average (GPA). Applicants are evaluated on the basis of their performance in previous academic work, the statement of purpose and personal history, the quality of the writing sample, and the strength of the letters of recommendation.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Sociology

Requirements: The minimum graduate admission requirements are: (1) A bachelor’s degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution; (2) A satisfactory scholastic average, usually a minimum grade-point average (GPA) of 3.0 (B) on a 4.0 scale; and (3) Enough undergraduate training to do graduate work in your chosen field. Applicants must also submit a Statement of Purpose, Personal History Statement, 3 Letters of Recommendation, Transcripts, and a Writing Sample.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in South and Southeast Asian Studies

Requirements: The Department of Spanish & Portuguese offers programs of study for the PhD in Spanish & Portuguese and the PhD in Hispanic Languages & Literatures. The department does not offer a terminal MA degree. Students are admitted to the PhD program. Students who have not yet earned an MA will earn the degree while working toward the PhD.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Spanish and Portuguese

Requirements: A bachelor's degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution. A minimum grade-point average (GPA) of 3.0 (B) on a 4.0 scale. For admission to the Master of Arts program, a bachelor's degree in any field is acceptable, but the applicant must have had some basic training in mathematics, including at least three semesters of calculus, a semester of linear algebra, and a semester of real analysis. In addition, some exposure to probability and statistics is desirable. International applicants from countries where the official language is not English must provide evidence of English language proficiency.
Program name: Master of Arts in Statistics

Requirements: Prospective students should have a strong background in mathematics: at least three semesters of calculus, a course in linear algebra, and a course in real analysis. Some experience with probability and statistics is also desirable. Application Requirements: Statement of Purpose, Personal History Statement, 3 letters of recommendation, CV/Resume, Official Transcripts.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Statistics

Requirements: To apply for the Master of Translational Medicine, applicants must have a bachelor’s degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution and a minimum Grade Point Average (GPA) of 3.0 (B) on a 4.0 scale. Required application materials include three letters of recommendation, a Statement of Purpose, a Personal History Statement, and a current resume or CV. International applicants must also demonstrate English Language Proficiency (TOEFL or IELTS). Additionally, the program requires prerequisite knowledge in Calculus (one year), Physics (one year), Chemistry (one year), and Biology (one year).
Program name: Master of Translational Medicine

Requirements: General application requirements include: official transcripts, evidence of English language proficiency (for international applicants), Statement of Purpose, Personal History Statement, three letters of recommendation, current resume/CV, and a portfolio. The GRE (Graduate Record Examination) is not required for this program.
Program name: Master of Urban Design

Requirements: To apply for the Doctor of Philosophy in Vision Science, applicants must have a bachelor’s degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited institution and a minimum grade-point average (GPA) of B (3.0) or better. Required application materials include transcripts for all college-level work, three letters of recommendation, a Personal History Statement, a Statement of Purpose, and a current Resume or CV. International applicants from countries where the official language is not English must provide evidence of English Language Proficiency (TOEFL or IELTS scores). The Graduate Record Examination (GRE) is not required.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Vision Science

Requirements: To apply for the Designated Emphasis in Critical Theory, students must already be enrolled in a Ph.D. program at UC Berkeley. Applications are accepted twice annually. Required materials include: 1. A letter of intent (2-3 pages) describing the student’s interest in the DE, how their research relates to critical theory, and the courses they plan to take; 2. A curriculum vitae; 3. A writing sample (20-30 pages); 4. A letter of recommendation from the student’s faculty advisor supporting the application to the DE.
Program name: Designated Emphasis in Critical Theory

Requirements: Admission to the designated emphasis is contingent on prior admission to a PhD program at UC Berkeley. To apply, students must provide: 1. A complete application form (available from the Folklore Program office); 2. A description of the student's research project and its relation to folklore; 3. A recommendation from the student's advisor.
Program name: Designated Emphasis in Folklore

Requirements: Only currently enrolled UC Berkeley PhD students are eligible to apply for a Designated Emphasis. Applicants must submit: 1. A complete Application for Admission to the Designated Emphasis in Women, Gender, and Sexuality. 2. A brief statement of purpose (no more than 2 pages) describing the student's research interests and its relationship to Women, Gender, and Sexuality. 3. A letter of recommendation from a member of the Women, Gender, and Sexuality Graduate Group who has agreed to serve on the student's exam and/or dissertation committee. 4. A curriculum vitae.
Program name: Designated Emphasis in Women, Gender, and Sexuality

Requirements: To be eligible for the Designated Emphasis in European Studies, students must be enrolled in an existing PhD program at UC Berkeley. Admission is by application to the DE Committee. Required documents for the application include a completed application form, a statement of purpose (no more than 2 pages) describing the student’s interest in European Studies and how it relates to their doctoral research, a letter of recommendation from the student’s faculty advisor in their home department, and a curriculum vitae.
Program name: Designated Emphasis in European Studies

Requirements: Admission to the DE is by application to the DE Graduate Group. To be eligible to apply, students must be in good standing in a participating PhD program. Ideally, students should apply for the DE after their first or second year of graduate study, but before taking the PhD Qualifying Exam. Application requirements include: 1. Completion of the application form including the signature of the student’s PhD advisor. 2. Preparation of a 1-2 page statement of interest that includes: a description of the student’s research interests and its relationship to Nanoscale Science and Engineering, and how the student intends to fulfill the DE requirements (including a proposed list of courses). 3. Letter of Recommendation from the PhD advisor.
Program name: Designated Emphasis in Nanoscale Science and Engineering

Requirements: To apply for the Designated Emphasis in Energy Science and Technology (DEEST), students must: 1. Be a doctoral student in good standing at UC Berkeley. 2. Be enrolled in a PhD program in one of the participating departments (College of Engineering, College of Chemistry, College of Natural Resources, or Department of Physics). 3.
